name: Bottomless Potion of the Tower
flavor_text: When Royal Apothecary Jentulf said "If only there were a way to lessen the need for healing," Royal Blacksmith Akmmenn replied "I have an idea."
base_heal_pct_source: this row's own base_heal column: "60% of max Life", and every other row in this file says the same. Audit row 26

name: Bottomless Potion of the Diamond
power_text: Increases Resist All by %d for 5 seconds.
flavor_text: “It heals you, it helps you resist damage, and it cures warts!” -Royal Apothecary Jentulf, presenting his newest creation to the king.

name: Bottomless Potion of Regeneration
power_text: Restores an additional %d Life over 5 seconds.
flavor_text: “Does Your Majesty know what would serve his armies better than mere healing? Healing combined with more healing!” -Royal Apothecary Jentulf, advising His Majesty in council.

name: Bottomless Potion of the Leech
power_text: Increases Life per Hit by %d for 5 seconds.
flavor_text: “I don’t know how it works, but it’s safe to say that I am the finest apothecary of our age.” -Royal Apothecary Jentulf, in his speech to the Society of Apothecaries.

name: Bottomless Potion of Mutilation
power_text: Increases Life per Kill by %d for 5 seconds.
flavor_text: "Well, I had to test it on someone, didn't I? You're all just jealous!" -Royal Apothecary Jentulf at his trial, just before sentencing.

name: Bottomless Potion of Kulle-Aid
power_text: Drinking Kulle-Aid allows you to burst through walls summoned by Waller elites for 5 seconds.

name: Bottomless Potion of Rejuvenation
power_text: Restores %d%% resource when used below 50%% health.
flavor_text: "When you are losing a fight, healing is no help, as you'll just lose that health in turn. No, what you need is a potion that gives you energy. And I know how to make that potion!" -Prisoner Jentulf, in a letter to the King pleading for early release.

name: Bottomless Potion of Fear
power_text: Fears enemies within 12 yards for %d seconds.
flavor_text: “If I learned one thing from my years in the dungeons it’s this: fear is a great motivator. We all need some fear in our lives!” - Royal Apothecary Jentulf at his reinstatement ceremony.

name: Bottomless Potion of Amplification
power_text: Increases healing from all sources by %d%% for 5 seconds.
flavor_text: "Some of you claimed I lost the touch during my sojourn in the King's dungeon. To you I say, this potion amplifies healing and puts the lie to your feckless assertions! Yes, I'm back, lackies!" -Royal Apothecary Jentulf in his weekly address to the Society of Apothecaries.

name: Bottomless Potion of Chaos
power_text: Teleport to another location based on your missing health. Results may vary.
flavor_text: “In my workshop, when one sees liquid in a bottle, logic dictates that it is something beneficial. But bottle logic is wrong! My genius has transcended the beneficial. Now, I ride the waves of chaos. Chaos!” -Royal Apothecary Jentulf, in his final letter to the Society of Apothecaries, before his disappearance.

name: Bottomless Potion of the Unfettered
power_text: Become immune to control impairing effects for %d seconds after drinking this potion.
